contracts_changed: C-operation: versioned OperationRequest/OperationPlan and per-operation readiness states/facts/capabilities/actions.
C-input envelope: value source and optional source-scoped revision; CORE-04 still owns effective input resolution and conflict semantics.
C-diagnostic: backward-compatible code/message/hint plus proposed scoped severity, recovery actions and evidence state.
C-model identity envelope: model revision and per-probe module invocation identity; MODEL owns evidence production and dynamic contract semantics.
C-edit envelope: edit plan/base revision and explicit model/optimizer/RNG/data/scheduler state impact; EDIT owns operation payload and migration algorithms.
C-run/C-artifact envelope: operation events, progress bounds, artifact owner and digest; RUN owns persistence, supervision and lifecycle.
Module ownership and native callable protocol boundaries for model, edit, train, run, extension, data, environment, CLI and acceptance.
implemented: Added Rust serializable domain types and structural validators for ready/needs_input/unsupported/conditional/unknown plans, required inputs/capabilities, source revisions, edit state impact, invocation identity, progress and artifact integrity.
InputBinding Debug output redacts sensitive values; legacy Diagnostic JSON remains byte-shape compatible when optional details are absent.
Added proposed OperationPlanner, OperationExecutor, OperationEventSource and ArtifactReferenceResolver ports. Existing Backend/Report remain the implemented runtime boundary until CORE-03 migration.

operations.json is a Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema, includes G-validation operation requirements and a field-by-field mapping from current inspect/probe/verify/train/edit/component reports to proposed contracts.
module-interfaces.json assigns field ownership, producer/consumer boundaries, callable signatures, compatibility rules and implemented-versus-proposed status.
